review.summary: Full re-verify with brute-force scripts. Confirmed: Q1–Q11, Q13, Q15–Q25 answers, steps, breakdowns, en/id parity, figures vs scans (metro graph edges, maze walls, spiral grid, trigrid vertices all match), choice renderer for Q15. Q11 diff=12 is forced (unique 4-sector split with two 26s leaves {7,19}). Q23 count=8 re-derived from grid [[1,2,3],[8,9,4],[7,6,5]] (no scan exists; grid taken from NumberGrid23G3Illustration). Q25: Dijkstra over (cell,heading) with straight-or-right moves on the scan-verified walls gives exactly 31. Q14 FIXED: unique overbar reconstruction 5 2̄ 3 6̄ (=4824) − 3 4̄ 7̄ 1 (=2531) = 2293 = key B (proved unique over all 64 bar assignments); body/hints/breakdown updated. Q12 remains the sole blocker.

findings.note: BLOCKED. No breakdown, no hint_steps, no figure_url — the fixed framing shape is missing from the OCR. Brute force over ALL 204 three-cell shapes (4×4 offset box, both Sun-start and Mon-start July-2023 calendars) finds NO shape for which 46 is impossible while 22/73/61/64 are all achievable — so the key A=46 cannot be reproduced by any candidate shape; the choices or key may also be OCR-corrupted. Needs the original PDF figure, then enrichment.

RESOLVED 2026-07-04: OCR had dropped the overbars from the operands. Among all 2^6 bar placements over '5236 − 3471' (leading digits unbarred), exactly one yields an offered choice matching the key: 5 2̄ 3 6̄ (=4824) − 3 4̄ 7̄ 1 (=2531) = 2293 = B. Body, hints, and breakdown updated accordingly. No illustration/explainer component yet (text-only question).

No scan (2023-final-g3-a-q23.jpg absent). Count = 8 brute-force verified against the grid [[1,2,3],[8,9,4],[7,6,5]] encoded in NumberGrid23G3Illustration, which is consistent with the hint's six transversal sets — but the grid values could not be checked against the original scan.

questions.body_en: Measure with your eyes instead of using measuring tools. Arrange ∠1, ∠2, ∠3, and ∠4 from the largest to the smallest.
questions.body_id: Ukur dengan mata, tanpa menggunakan alat ukur. Urutkan ∠1, ∠2, ∠3, dan ∠4 dari yang terbesar ke yang terkecil.
hint_steps_en: ∠4 is a right angle (90°) — the only square corner, so it is the biggest.
Of the others, the M's wide bottom ∠3 is most open, then ∠2, then the W's sharp ∠1.
Largest to smallest: ∠4 > ∠3 > ∠2 > ∠1 → choice C.
hint_steps_id: ∠4 adalah sudut siku-siku (90°) — satu-satunya sudut persegi, jadi yang terbesar.
Dari sisanya, sudut bawah M yang lebar ∠3 paling terbuka, lalu ∠2, lalu ∠1 yang lancip pada W.
Dari terbesar ke terkecil: ∠4 > ∠3 > ∠2 > ∠1 → pilihan C.

questions.body_en: Jenny drinks 1/12 L of milk for breakfast on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and 3/12 L of milk for breakfast on Tuesdays and Thursdays. How many liters of milk does she drink for breakfast from Monday to Friday?

hint_steps_en: Mon, Wed, Fri: 3 days × 1/12 = 3/12 L.
Tue, Thu: 2 days × 3/12 = 6/12 L.
Add them: 3/12 + 6/12 = 9/12 L → choice E.
hint_steps_id: Sen, Rab, Jum: 3 hari × 1/12 = 3/12 L.
Sel, Kam: 2 hari × 3/12 = 6/12 L.
Jumlahkan: 3/12 + 6/12 = 9/12 L → pilihan E.

questions.body_en: Two identical rectangles overlap with each other, and the overlapping part is a square. Find the perimeter of this figure.
questions.body_id: Dua persegi panjang yang identik saling bertumpang tindih, dan bagian yang bertumpang tindih berbentuk persegi. Tentukan keliling bangun ini.
hint_steps_en: Each rectangle is 56 × 42, so one border is 2 × (56 + 42) = 196.
The 36 is the part of a 56-side past the overlap, so the square's side is 56 − 36 = 20.
Two borders minus the 4 hidden square sides: 2 × 196 − 4 × 20 = 392 − 80 = 312 → choice E.
hint_steps_id: Tiap persegi panjang 56 × 42, jadi satu keliling = 2 × (56 + 42) = 196.
Angka 36 adalah bagian sisi 56 di luar tumpang tindih, jadi sisi persegi = 56 − 36 = 20.
Dua keliling dikurangi 4 sisi persegi tersembunyi: 2 × 196 − 4 × 20 = 392 − 80 = 312 → pilihan E.

questions.body_en: A snail can only crawl in straight lines and make right-angle turns. Starting from point A, it crawls north for 14 cm, west for 12 cm, east for 29 cm, and south for 5 cm. At least how many centimeters must it crawl to get back to point A?
questions.body_id: Seekor siput hanya dapat merayap lurus dan berbelok siku-siku. Mulai dari titik A, ia merayap ke utara 14 cm, ke barat 12 cm, ke timur 29 cm, dan ke selatan 5 cm. Paling sedikit berapa sentimeter ia harus merayap untuk kembali ke titik A?
hint_steps_en: Up and down: 14 north − 5 south = 9 cm north of A.
Left and right: 29 east − 12 west = 17 cm east of A.
Shortest way back = 17 + 9 = 26 cm → choice D.
hint_steps_id: Atas dan bawah: 14 utara − 5 selatan = 9 cm di utara A.
Kiri dan kanan: 29 timur − 12 barat = 17 cm di timur A.
Jalan pulang terpendek = 17 + 9 = 26 cm → pilihan D.

highlights.phrase_en: north for 14 cm, west for 12 cm, east for 29 cm, and south for 5 cm
highlights.phrase_id: ke utara 14 cm, ke barat 12 cm, ke timur 29 cm, dan ke selatan 5 cm
highlights.note_en: Four right-angle moves — combine the opposite ones.
highlights.note_id: Empat gerakan siku-siku — gabungkan yang berlawanan.

highlights.phrase_en: At least how many centimeters must it crawl to get back to point A?
highlights.phrase_id: Paling sedikit berapa sentimeter ia harus merayap untuk kembali ke titik A?
highlights.note_en: Find the shortest right-angle path home.
highlights.note_id: Cari jalur siku-siku terpendek untuk pulang.

trap.why_en: 34 = 12 + 9 + 13 adds back travel already cancelled; only the net 17 + 9 matters.
trap.why_id: 34 menambahkan kembali gerak yang sudah saling meniadakan; hanya selisih 17 + 9 yang penting.

questions.body_en: A document has 463 pages. It takes Chen 3 days to work on 174 pages. At this speed, he continues to work for the remaining 4 days of the week. How many pages are left for him to work on next week?
questions.body_id: Sebuah dokumen memiliki 463 halaman. Chen membutuhkan 3 hari untuk mengerjakan 174 halaman. Dengan kecepatan ini, ia melanjutkan pekerjaannya selama 4 hari sisa minggu itu. Berapa halaman yang tersisa untuk dikerjakan minggu depan?
hint_steps_en: Chen's rate: 174 ÷ 3 = 58 pages per day.
In 4 more days he does 4 × 58 = 232 pages, so this week's total is 174 + 232 = 406.
Pages left: 463 − 406 = 57 → choice A.
hint_steps_id: Kecepatan Chen: 174 ÷ 3 = 58 halaman per hari.
Dalam 4 hari lagi ia mengerjakan 4 × 58 = 232 halaman, jadi total minggu ini 174 + 232 = 406.
Halaman tersisa: 463 − 406 = 57 → pilihan A.

highlights.phrase_en: 3 days to work on 174 pages
highlights.phrase_id: 3 hari untuk mengerjakan 174 halaman
highlights.note_en: This gives the daily rate.
highlights.note_id: Ini memberi kecepatan per hari.

highlights.phrase_en: the remaining 4 days of the week
highlights.phrase_id: 4 hari sisa minggu itu
highlights.note_en: Four more days at the same rate.

highlights.phrase_en: How many pages are left for him to work on next week?

strategy.name_en: Find the daily rate, total this week, subtract from 463
strategy.name_id: Cari kecepatan harian, total minggu ini, kurangi dari 463

questions.body_en: The parking fees for small cars and big cars are shown below. Small car: $5 for the first hour, then $3 for each hour after. Big car: $7 for the first hour, then $5 for each hour after. Kevin parks a small car and Josh parks a big car, and their parking fees are the same. At least how many hours in total do they park their cars?
questions.body_id: Tarif parkir untuk mobil kecil dan mobil besar ditunjukkan di bawah. Mobil kecil: $5 untuk jam pertama, lalu $3 untuk setiap jam berikutnya. Mobil besar: $7 untuk jam pertama, lalu $5 untuk setiap jam berikutnya. Kevin memarkir mobil kecil dan Josh memarkir mobil besar, dan biaya parkir mereka sama. Paling sedikit berapa jam total mereka memarkir mobil?
hint_steps_en: Small car cost grows 5, 8, 11, 14, 17 (3 per extra hour).
Big car cost grows 7, 12, 17 (5 per extra hour).
They first match at $17: small at 5 hours, big at 3 hours → total 5 + 3 = 8 → choice B.
hint_steps_id: Biaya mobil kecil naik 5, 8, 11, 14, 17 (3 per jam tambahan).
Biaya mobil besar naik 7, 12, 17 (5 per jam tambahan).
Pertama kali sama di $17: mobil kecil 5 jam, mobil besar 3 jam → total 5 + 3 = 8 → pilihan B.

questions.body_en: Each circle represents a metro station, and the number next to a line segment is the ticket price for that segment. Kelly wants to travel from station A to station B. What is the least amount of money she needs to buy a ticket?
questions.body_id: Setiap lingkaran mewakili sebuah stasiun metro, dan angka di samping ruas garis adalah harga tiket untuk ruas itu. Kelly ingin pergi dari stasiun A ke stasiun B. Berapa biaya tiket paling murah yang ia perlukan?
hint_steps_en: From A, the cheaper start is A → station → 50, then 20 to the hub (running 70).
From the hub, going straight to B costs 90 (total 160), but hopping via the next station costs 10 + 70 = 80 (total 150).
Cheapest A → B = 50 + 20 + 10 + 70 = 150 → choice C.
hint_steps_id: Dari A, awal termurah A → stasiun → 50, lalu 20 ke pusat (jumlah 70).
Dari pusat, langsung ke B biayanya 90 (total 160), tetapi lewat stasiun berikut biayanya 10 + 70 = 80 (total 150).
Termurah A → B = 50 + 20 + 10 + 70 = 150 → pilihan C.

questions.body_en: Use the six digits 0, 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9 (each exactly once) to form a 6-digit number in which the hundreds digit is 5 and the ten-thousands digit is 9. Let M be the difference between the largest and the smallest such 6-digit number. Find the sum of all the digits of M.
questions.body_id: Gunakan enam angka 0, 1, 3, 5, 7, dan 9 (masing-masing tepat sekali) untuk membentuk bilangan 6 angka dengan angka ratusan 5 dan angka puluhan ribu 9. Misalkan M adalah selisih antara bilangan 6 angka terbesar dan terkecil seperti itu. Tentukan jumlah semua angka dari M.
hint_steps_en: Fix 9 in the ten-thousands place and 5 in the hundreds place; fill the rest with 0, 1, 3, 7.
Largest = 793510, smallest = 190537 (it can't start with 0).
hint_steps_id: Tetapkan 9 di puluhan ribu dan 5 di ratusan; isi sisanya dengan 0, 1, 3, 7.
Terbesar = 793510, terkecil = 190537 (tidak boleh diawali 0).

highlights.phrase_en: the hundreds digit is 5 and the ten-thousands digit is 9
highlights.phrase_id: angka ratusan 5 dan angka puluhan ribu 9

highlights.note_id: Dua tempat tetap; susun 0,1,3,7 di sisanya.

highlights.phrase_id: jumlah semua angka dari M

questions.body_en: When Alvin uses a calculator to solve a division problem, he accidentally swaps the first two digits of the dividend. The divisor is 6, and the quotient he gets is 576. What is the correct quotient?
questions.body_id: Ketika Alvin menggunakan kalkulator untuk menyelesaikan soal pembagian, ia tidak sengaja menukar dua angka pertama dari bilangan yang dibagi. Pembaginya adalah 6, dan hasil bagi yang ia peroleh adalah 576. Berapa hasil bagi yang benar?
hint_steps_en: The wrong dividend is 576 × 6 = 3456.
Un-swap the first two digits: 3456 → 4356.
Correct quotient = 4356 ÷ 6 = 726 → choice D.
hint_steps_id: Bilangan yang dibagi yang salah = 576 × 6 = 3456.
Kembalikan dua angka pertama: 3456 → 4356.
Hasil bagi yang benar = 4356 ÷ 6 = 726 → pilihan D.

questions.body_en: A complete clock face has the 12 numbers on it. Milly accidentally breaks it into 4 sector-shaped pieces. The numbers on two of the pieces each add up to 26. Find the difference between the sums of the numbers on the other two pieces.
questions.body_id: Sebuah permukaan jam lengkap memiliki 12 angka. Milly tidak sengaja memecahkannya menjadi 4 keping berbentuk juring. Jumlah angka pada dua keping masing-masing adalah 26. Tentukan selisih antara jumlah angka pada dua keping lainnya.
hint_steps_en: All twelve numbers add to 1+2+…+12 = 78.
The two pieces summing to 26 take 26 + 26 = 52, so the other two together make 78 − 52 = 26.
Those pieces are {3,4}=7 and {9,10}=19, so the difference is 19 − 7 = 12 → choice D.
hint_steps_id: Kedua belas angka berjumlah 1+2+…+12 = 78.
Dua keping yang berjumlah 26 mengambil 26 + 26 = 52, jadi dua keping lainnya bersama 78 − 52 = 26.
Keping itu adalah {3,4}=7 dan {9,10}=19, jadi selisihnya 19 − 7 = 12 → pilihan D.

highlights.phrase_en: The numbers on two of the pieces each add up to 26
highlights.phrase_id: Jumlah angka pada dua keping masing-masing adalah 26
highlights.note_en: Two pieces remove 52 from the total.
highlights.note_id: Dua keping mengambil 52 dari total.

highlights.phrase_id: selisih antara jumlah angka pada dua keping lainnya
highlights.note_en: Split the leftover 26 into its two pieces.
highlights.note_id: Bagi sisa 26 menjadi dua kepingnya.

strategy.name_en: Use the total 78, subtract the two 26s, split the rest
strategy.name_id: Pakai total 78, kurangi dua angka 26, bagi sisanya

questions.body_en: A certain tribe writes numbers with a special method for addition and subtraction: a bar over a digit means that digit is subtracted. For example, 9 = 1 1̄ ( = 10 − 1 ), 197 = 2 0 3̄ ( = 200 − 3 ), and 6745 = 1 3̄ 2̄ 6̄ 5 ( = 10000 − 3260 + 5 ). In this tribe, what number does the result of 5 2̄ 3 6̄ − 3 4̄ 7̄ 1 represent?
questions.body_id: Suatu suku menulis bilangan dengan metode khusus untuk penjumlahan dan pengurangan: garis di atas sebuah angka berarti angka itu dikurangkan. Contohnya, 9 = 1 1̄ ( = 10 − 1 ), 197 = 2 0 3̄ ( = 200 − 3 ), dan 6745 = 1 3̄ 2̄ 6̄ 5 ( = 10000 − 3260 + 5 ). Pada suku ini, bilangan berapa yang diwakili oleh hasil dari 5 2̄ 3 6̄ − 3 4̄ 7̄ 1?
hint_steps_en: Read each tribe numeral by place value, subtracting every barred digit: 5 2̄ 3 6̄ = 5000 − 200 + 30 − 6 = 4824.
Subtract the two ordinary numbers: 4824 − 2531 = 2293 → choice B.
hint_steps_id: Baca tiap bilangan suku menurut nilai tempat, kurangkan setiap angka bergaris: 5 2̄ 3 6̄ = 5000 − 200 + 30 − 6 = 4824.
Kurangkan kedua bilangan biasa: 4824 − 2531 = 2293 → pilihan B.

highlights.phrase_en: a bar over a digit means that digit is subtracted
highlights.phrase_id: garis di atas sebuah angka berarti angka itu dikurangkan
highlights.note_en: Barred digits count as minus at their place value.
highlights.note_id: Angka bergaris dihitung minus pada nilai tempatnya.

highlights.note_en: Turn both tribe numerals into ordinary numbers first.
highlights.note_id: Ubah dulu kedua bilangan suku menjadi bilangan biasa.

strategy.name_en: Translate each tribe numeral to an ordinary number, then subtract
strategy.name_id: Terjemahkan tiap bilangan suku ke bilangan biasa, lalu kurangkan

trap.why_en: 1765 = 5236 − 3471 as if there were no bars — the barred digits must be subtracted before computing.
trap.why_id: 1765 = 5236 − 3471 seolah tanpa garis — angka bergaris harus dikurangkan dulu sebelum menghitung.

questions.body_en: Triangle ABC is folded along EF, so that B maps to B' and C maps to C'. If ∠EAF = 60° and ∠B'EA = 95°, find ∠AFC' (in degrees).
questions.body_id: Segitiga ABC dilipat sepanjang EF, sehingga B berpindah ke B' dan C berpindah ke C'. Jika ∠EAF = 60° dan ∠B'EA = 95°, tentukan ∠AFC' (dalam derajat).
hint_steps_en: In triangle AEF, ∠AEF + ∠AFE = 180 − 60 = 120°.
Folding doubles the crease angles: ∠B'EA = 180 − 2∠AEF and ∠AFC' = 180 − 2∠AFE, so ∠B'EA + ∠AFC' = 2 × 60 = 120°.
hint_steps_id: Pada segitiga AEF, ∠AEF + ∠AFE = 180 − 60 = 120°.
Lipatan menggandakan sudut lipatan: ∠B'EA = 180 − 2∠AEF dan ∠AFC' = 180 − 2∠AFE, jadi ∠B'EA + ∠AFC' = 2 × 60 = 120°.

questions.body_en: Five squares are arranged side by side on a straight line. From the shortest to the longest, their side lengths are 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Find the area of the shaded region.
questions.body_id: Lima persegi disusun berdampingan pada satu garis lurus. Dari yang terpendek ke terpanjang, panjang sisinya adalah 2, 3, 4, 5, dan 6. Tentukan luas daerah yang diarsir.
hint_steps_en: Each shaded triangle has base s and height s, so its area is s²/2 — half of its square.
The five squares total 4 + 9 + 16 + 25 + 36 = 90.
Shaded = half of 90 = 45.
hint_steps_id: Setiap segitiga yang diarsir beralas s dan tinggi s, jadi luasnya s²/2 — setengah perseginya.
Kelima persegi berjumlah 4 + 9 + 16 + 25 + 36 = 90.
Daerah diarsir = setengah dari 90 = 45.

strategy.name_id: Tiap segitiga kipas setengah perseginya, jadi arsir = setengah luas total

questions.body_en: The figure is made up of 4 identical rectangles. The perimeter of the whole figure is 48 cm and its area is 90 cm². Find the perimeter of one rectangle in cm.
questions.body_id: Bangun tersebut tersusun dari 4 persegi panjang yang identik. Keliling seluruh bangun adalah 48 cm dan luasnya 90 cm². Tentukan keliling satu persegi panjang dalam cm.
hint_steps_en: The pinwheel's perimeter is 4(L+W) + 4(L−W) = 8L = 48, so L = 6.
Its area is 4 × L × W = 90, so L × W = 22.5 and W = 22.5 ÷ 6 = 3.75.
One rectangle's perimeter = 2 × (6 + 3.75) = 19.5 cm.
hint_steps_id: Keliling kincir = 4(L+W) + 4(L−W) = 8L = 48, jadi L = 6.
Luasnya = 4 × L × W = 90, jadi L × W = 22.5 dan W = 22.5 ÷ 6 = 3.75.
Keliling satu persegi panjang = 2 × (6 + 3.75) = 19.5 cm.

questions.body_en: A, B, C, and D are four consecutive 3-digit integers with A < B < C < D. A is divisible by 3, B is divisible by 5, C is divisible by 7, and D is divisible by 9. Find the largest possible value of D.
questions.body_id: A, B, C, dan D adalah empat bilangan bulat tiga angka berurutan dengan A < B < C < D. A habis dibagi 3, B habis dibagi 5, C habis dibagi 7, dan D habis dibagi 9. Tentukan nilai terbesar yang mungkin untuk D.
hint_steps_en: Let A be the first number: A ÷ 3, (A+1) ÷ 5, (A+2) ÷ 7, (A+3) ÷ 9 all have remainder 0.
Combining these, A can be 159, 474, or 789 (they repeat every 315).
The largest with D = A+3 still a 3-digit number is A = 789, so D = 792.
hint_steps_id: Misalkan A bilangan pertama: A ÷ 3, (A+1) ÷ 5, (A+2) ÷ 7, (A+3) ÷ 9 semua bersisa 0.
Menggabungkannya, A bisa 159, 474, atau 789 (berulang setiap 315).
Terbesar dengan D = A+3 masih 3 angka adalah A = 789, jadi D = 792.

highlights.phrase_en: A is divisible by 3, B is divisible by 5, C is divisible by 7, and D is divisible by 9
highlights.phrase_id: A habis dibagi 3, B habis dibagi 5, C habis dibagi 7, dan D habis dibagi 9
highlights.note_en: Four remainder conditions on consecutive numbers.
highlights.note_id: Empat syarat sisa pada bilangan berurutan.

highlights.phrase_en: Find the largest possible value of D
highlights.phrase_id: Tentukan nilai terbesar yang mungkin untuk D
highlights.note_en: Take the biggest 3-digit solution.
highlights.note_id: Ambil solusi 3 angka terbesar.

strategy.name_en: Turn all four conditions onto A, combine them, take the largest 3-digit A
strategy.name_id: Ubah keempat syarat ke A, gabungkan, ambil A 3 angka terbesar

questions.body_en: Jones plays a challenge game with 9 challenges numbered 1 to 9; each challenge is worth points equal to its number. Every player starts with 50 points. Passing a challenge earns its points; failing a challenge deducts its points. For example, passing challenge 3 gains 3 points, while failing it loses 3 points. After Jones attempts all the challenges, his total is 73 points. He fails challenges a, b, c, and d (from smallest to largest). Find the 4-digit number abcd.
questions.body_id: Jones bermain permainan tantangan dengan 9 tantangan bernomor 1 sampai 9; setiap tantangan bernilai poin sama dengan nomornya. Setiap pemain mulai dengan 50 poin. Lulus sebuah tantangan menambah poinnya; gagal sebuah tantangan mengurangi poinnya. Misalnya, lulus tantangan 3 menambah 3 poin, sedangkan gagal mengurangi 3 poin. Setelah Jones mencoba semua tantangan, totalnya 73 poin. Ia gagal pada tantangan a, b, c, dan d (dari terkecil ke terbesar). Tentukan bilangan 4 angka abcd.
hint_steps_en: If Jones passed everything he'd have 50 + (1+2+…+9) = 95 points.
He has 73 — a drop of 22; each failed challenge i costs 2×i, so the failed numbers add to 11.
Four different challenges from 1–9 adding to 11: 1, 2, 3, 5 → abcd = 1235.
hint_steps_id: Jika Jones lulus semua, ia punya 50 + (1+2+…+9) = 95 poin.
Ia punya 73 — turun 22; tiap tantangan gagal i mengurangi 2×i, jadi nomor yang gagal berjumlah 11.
Empat tantangan berbeda 1–9 yang berjumlah 11: 1, 2, 3, 5 → abcd = 1235.

highlights.phrase_en: his total is 73 points
highlights.phrase_id: totalnya 73 poin
highlights.note_en: Compare with the all-pass score of 95.
highlights.note_id: Bandingkan dengan skor lulus semua 95.

questions.body_en: The same x matchsticks can be arranged into a 1×a array of unit squares, a 2×b array of unit squares, or a 4×c array of unit squares. Given that x is less than 100, find the sum of the largest and the smallest possible values of x.
questions.body_id: x batang korek api yang sama dapat disusun menjadi susunan persegi satuan 1×a, susunan persegi satuan 2×b, atau susunan persegi satuan 4×c. Jika x kurang dari 100, tentukan jumlah nilai terbesar dan terkecil yang mungkin untuk x.
hint_steps_en: Matchsticks: a 1×a block needs 3a+1, a 2×b block needs 5b+2, a 4×c block needs 9c+4.
Under 100, the totals that fit all three layouts are x = 22 and x = 67.
hint_steps_id: Batang korek api: blok 1×a perlu 3a+1, blok 2×b perlu 5b+2, blok 4×c perlu 9c+4.
Di bawah 100, total yang cocok ketiga susunan adalah x = 22 dan x = 67.

questions.body_en: From the grid below, pick three numbers so that no two of them are in the same row or the same column, and use them to form a 3-digit number. How many of these 3-digit numbers are divisible by 4?
questions.body_id: Dari kisi di bawah, pilih tiga angka sehingga tidak ada dua angka yang berada di baris atau kolom yang sama, lalu gunakan untuk membentuk bilangan 3 angka. Berapa banyak bilangan 3 angka seperti itu yang habis dibagi 4?
hint_steps_en: Pick one number per row in different columns → 6 sets: {1,9,5}, {1,4,6}, {2,8,5}, {2,4,7}, {3,8,6}, {3,9,7}.
A number is divisible by 4 when its last two digits are; count per set: 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0.
Total = 8.
hint_steps_id: Pilih satu angka per baris di kolom berbeda → 6 himpunan: {1,9,5}, {1,4,6}, {2,8,5}, {2,4,7}, {3,8,6}, {3,9,7}.
Bilangan habis dibagi 4 jika dua angka terakhirnya begitu; hitung per himpunan: 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0.
Total = 8.

questions.body_en: Delete 100 digits from the number 1234567891011121314…57585960 (the whole numbers from 1 to 60 written in order). What is the largest number that can remain?
questions.body_id: Hapus 100 angka dari bilangan 1234567891011121314…57585960 (bilangan bulat 1 sampai 60 yang ditulis berurutan). Berapa bilangan terbesar yang dapat tersisa?
hint_steps_en: Writing 1 to 60 in a row gives 111 digits; deleting 100 leaves 11, which we want as large as possible.
Grab the biggest digit you can as early as possible (while still leaving enough digits after it): the 9s from 9, 19, 29, 39, 49 give five leading 9s.
Filling the last 6 places greedily from what remains gives 99999785960.
hint_steps_id: Menulis 1 sampai 60 berurutan menghasilkan 111 angka; menghapus 100 menyisakan 11, yang ingin kita buat sebesar mungkin.
Ambil angka terbesar sedini mungkin (selama masih cukup angka setelahnya): angka 9 dari 9, 19, 29, 39, 49 memberi lima angka 9 di depan.
Mengisi 6 tempat terakhir secara serakah dari sisanya menghasilkan 99999785960.

highlights.phrase_id: bilangan bulat 1 sampai 60 yang ditulis berurutan

highlights.phrase_id: Berapa bilangan terbesar yang dapat tersisa?
highlights.note_en: Keep 11 digits in order, as large as possible.

questions.body_en: A robot wants to pass through a square-grid maze. Its left-turn and reverse functions are broken, so it can only go straight or turn right. The same square may be passed through more than once. What is the least number of squares the robot passes through to get through the maze? (Every square it passes through is counted, including repeats.)
questions.body_id: Sebuah robot ingin melewati labirin kisi persegi. Fungsi belok kiri dan mundurnya rusak, jadi ia hanya bisa lurus atau belok kanan. Kotak yang sama boleh dilewati lebih dari sekali. Paling sedikit berapa banyak kotak yang dilewati robot untuk menembus labirin? (Setiap kotak yang dilewati dihitung, termasuk pengulangan.)
hint_steps_en: The robot enters facing right and can only go straight or turn right — never left or back.
That forces one long winding route; some squares must be crossed twice because it can't turn left.
Counting every square it enters (repeats included) gives 31.
hint_steps_id: Robot masuk menghadap kanan dan hanya bisa lurus atau belok kanan — tidak pernah kiri atau mundur.
Itu memaksa satu rute panjang berliku; beberapa kotak harus dilewati dua kali karena tak bisa belok kiri.
Menghitung setiap kotak yang dimasuki (termasuk pengulangan) menghasilkan 31.

highlights.phrase_en: it can only go straight or turn right
highlights.phrase_id: ia hanya bisa lurus atau belok kanan
highlights.note_en: No left turn and no reverse — the route is forced.
highlights.note_id: Tanpa belok kiri dan tanpa mundur — rutenya terpaksa.

highlights.phrase_en: What is the least number of squares the robot passes through to get through the maze?

highlights.note_en: Count every square entered, repeats included.
highlights.note_id: Hitung setiap kotak yang dimasuki, termasuk pengulangan.
